security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: http://asset.localhost; media-src 'self' http://asset.localhost; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Animated desktop wallpapers that rest when you work
bundle.longDescription: Sarab plays videos, GIFs, web pages and pictures behind the desktop icons on every display, and pauses itself when an app covers the screen, on battery, or when the screen is locked.
